items.name: datetime-picker
items.title: Date Time Picker
items.description: A date and time picker for shadcn/ui with a Material UI-inspired experience, supporting calendar selection, time selection, 12/24-hour formats, and configurable granularity.
items.docs: Import from @/components/datetime-picker/datetime-picker. Values are @internationalized/date DateValue objects; always pass value (null when empty). Inside a shadcn <Field>, give the picker an id and use <FieldLabel htmlFor={id}> instead of the label prop. onChange receives the value, not an event. React Hook Form: <DateTimePicker {...field} id aria-invalid={fieldState.invalid} />. TanStack Form: value={field.state.value} onChange={field.handleChange} onBlur={field.handleBlur}. Formisch: <DateTimePicker {...field.props} value={field.input ?? null} onChange={field.onChange} />. Examples: add datetime-picker-demo, datetime-picker-react-hook-form, datetime-picker-tanstack-form, or datetime-picker-formisch from this registry. Docs: https://github.com/mrphilipp7/shadcn-datetime-picker#readme
